name: io.github.Vaquill-AI/canlii-mcp
title: CanLII
description: MCP for CanLII: Canadian case law and legislation metadata (federal, provincial, territorial).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Only for self-hosted deployments that set MCP_AUTH_TOKEN. The public hosted endpoint at canlii-mcp.vaquill.ai does not use it, so leave this blank. Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

headers.name: X-CanLII-Token
headers.description: Your CanLII API key. Apply for one at https://www.canlii.org/en/feedback/feedback.html. Header-less clients can instead append ?token=<key> to the endpoint URL. The server never stores your key.
